name: DUSTWALL RACING: Underground Urban Speed Circuit
description: DUSTWALL RACING is GLMZ's primary underground vehicle racing circuit, run through the decommissioned industrial corridors, flooded sub-basement networks, and maintenance arterials of the Gray Zone and lower Tier 2 infrastructure. Racers pilot heavily modified personal transport vehicles — stripped-down cargo movers, stolen enforcement bikes, custom-built low-chassis runners — through routes that change weekly to avoid enforcement mapping. BCI-linked race officials coordinate via pirate mesh, and spectators gather at known checkpoint nodes to watch runs in person or via illegal feed relay.
story_hooks: A legendary DUSTWALL runner agrees to throw a race for a debt payment and then doesn't — setting off a chain of consequences that pulls in players from the Gray Zone all the way to a Tier 4 betting syndicate.
A character investigating the Ward Six collapse discovers the structural failure wasn't accidental — the sub-basement had been deliberately weakened to justify an infrastructure seizure.

A Tier 3 entertainment operator trying to legitimize DUSTWALL as a sanctioned product finds themselves targeted by both enforcement and the underground operators who don't want the circuit cleaned up.
